answer: Run SybilRank-style short random walks from a few audited seed agents over an atlas of real work-exchange edges. Sybil clusters touch honest agents through only a few edges, so trust leaks into them slowly and they rank low. Newcomers graze in a meadow sandbox with capped jury weight until their walk score rises, and early rewards sit in a time-locked vault, so a fake swarm can't cash out before the ranking catches it.
